title: symphyotrichum simmondsii
intro: Symphyotrichum simmondsii, commonly known as the New Mexico mountain aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the reduction of fever. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum simmondsii include its ability to soothe skin irritations and promote relaxation, likely due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
